extension.description: Diagnose the current workspace for God Classes, technical debt, security issues, and dependency structure.
codeDoctor.setLlmApiKey: Codes Doctor: Set LLM API Key
config.reportOpenMode.description: How to open generated reports: external browser, VS Code WebView, or VS Code URI open.
config.analysisLanguage.description: Language mode used when analyzing the workspace.
config.llmProvider.description: LLM provider used for the optional AI structural review. Set the matching API key via the "Codes Doctor: Set LLM API Key" command.
config.llmModel.description: Model ID to use for LLM review. Leave empty to pick one from the Dashboard's model list (fetched live from the provider).
config.displayLanguage.description: Dashboard, new report, and AI review language. English by default. Run a new analysis after changing this setting; existing reports keep their original language.
config.llmProvider.option.2: VS Code Built-in AI (GitHub Copilot / vscode.lm — No API Key)
config.llmOutputMode.description: What the LLM produces: a structural review report for people to read, or a task prompt you can paste into an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex).
codeDoctor.copySummaryJson: Codes Doctor: Copy Analysis Summary as JSON
codeDoctor.copyAiAgentPrompt: Codes Doctor: Copy Prompt for AI Agents (Copilot, Claude, Antigravity)
codeDoctor.previewAiFix: Codes Doctor: Preview AI Fix in Diff Editor
chatParticipant.description: AI software architecture and security assistant powered by Codes Doctor analysis.
chatParticipant.cmd.analyze: Summarize the latest Codes Doctor workspace analysis
chatParticipant.cmd.security: Explain traced security vulnerabilities and remediation
chatParticipant.cmd.refactor: Propose a refactoring plan for God Classes and circular dependencies
chatParticipant.cmd.fix: Generate an AI code fix and open a side-by-side Diff Preview
chatParticipant.cmd.prompt: Output structured task instructions for AI agents without calling external LLM
config.llmMaxOutputTokens.description: Maximum generated tokens per initial LLM review request (input tokens are separate). Includes reasoning for OpenAI reasoning models. Starting points: 4,000–8,000 for non-reasoning models; 16,000–32,000 for reasoning models. Default: 16,000. Stay within the selected model’s output limit. Empty OpenAI output caused by the limit is retried once with max(2 × this value, 16,000); this can increase cost.
config.minSecurity.description: Warn if the security score is below this minimum (0-100). Set to 0 to disable.
config.minTechnicalDebt.description: Warn if the technical debt score is below this minimum (0-100). Set to 0 to disable.
config.outputDirectory.description: Custom directory for reports. Leave empty to use default extension global storage.
config.analyzeOnSave.description: Automatically re-run background analysis and update editor diagnostics when a file is saved.
codeDoctor.scanSecurityRules: Codes Doctor: Scan Workspace with Security Rules
codeDoctor.exportSecurityAuditReport: Codes Doctor: Export Security Audit Report
config.securityRules.sourceUrl.descripti: HTTPS URL of the security rules manifest (manifest.json), or a file: URL for a local or shared-drive copy. Each rule file is checked against the SHA-256 in the manifest before use. User settings only: a workspace cannot choose the rules it is checked with.
config.securityRules.autoSync.descriptio: Download the security rules when VS Code starts and at the sync interval. Off by default, so nothing is fetched until you run "Sync Security Rules".
config.securityRules.syncIntervalHours.d: Hours between automatic security rules syncs. Used only when autoSync is on.
